correctness.rationale: Exact pair-sum Parseval identity gives the phase-free quadratic form 2(Σwi pi)^2−Σwi²pi². For infinite B2 spectra the Poisson multiplier is compact from the L2 unit ball to L4: uniform tails bounded by (Σtail rho^{2ni})^{1/2}; a weakly compact maximizer exists. At every maximizer, simplex coordinate variations and positive Euler multiplier produce pi=2S(wi−t)_+/wi² and a unique waterline Σ(1−t/wi)_+=1/2. This proves the unique global squared magnitude profile and sharp t/D value, not merely a local stationary point. Monotonic scalar root equations yield unique strictly ordered thresholds, with rho_k→1 by an elementary geometric bound. Taylor expansion proves positive linear onset. At rho=1, the B2 moment gives the strict <2 inequality and flat truncations approach two. Rational script gives 1148 checks as finite corroboration; it is not an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: Best-knowledge statement and implication-level comparison. The 2021 primary hypercontractivity theorem concerns global contraction, not all supercritical restricted norms. The 2022 primary sparse circle extension theorem acts from circle L2 to Euclidean L6, not a circle L4 Poisson multiplier. A closely related public all-length B2 lacunary result is nondamped (rho=1). An earlier exact three-frequency Poisson result is subsumed as a special case; it does not imply an arbitrary finite or infinite activation staircase or nonattainment at infinite endpoint without a new uniform argument. Search did not identify an already formulated theorem of this strength. Historical priority remains a material residual risk.
residual_risks: An older general weighted Lambda(4) diagonal multiplier theorem may imply the KKT waterline and mode cascade without matching terminology.
The all-length theorem is a natural finite-dimension extension of known three-frequency and unweighted B2 results; novelty of its presentation depends on whether such synthesis is already documented.

value.rationale: A natural sparsity question in analytic Fourier Poisson smoothing asks which tones survive strong damping. The theorem gives an exact norm and every maximizer for arbitrary finite or infinite B2 spectra, an unbounded and individually ordered activation cascade whose radii accumulate at one, a sharp nondegenerate onset exponent, and an attainment/nonattainment distinction at the infinite endpoint. Those countably infinite phenomena cannot be seen in the known three-frequency calculation or rho=1 finite B2 norm. This is a structural class-wide classification, not a table recomputation or arbitrary parameter slice.
